name: SOURCE_DISCOVERY_EXACT
findings: Per-entity GET enumeration works for all three issuers via listaifi?nif= (IPP) and ListadoIFA?nif= (ESEF).
IPP enumeration (listaifi) returns a stable nreg per period: SAN/BBVA/IBE each expose 60 unique nreg, including the corpus slots H1-2024..H1-2026.
ESEF enumeration (ListadoIFA) returns a stable registro oficial per year: SAN FY2025=20875/FY2024=20509, BBVA FY2025=20854/FY2024=20448, IBE FY2025=20934/FY2024=20515.

Artefact chain: IPP = nreg -> detalleifialdia.aspx?nreg=<nreg> -> descargaxbrlipp.ashx?t={GUID} (ephemeral) -> redirect -> webservices/verdocumento/ver?e=<token> (stable) -> raw XML. ESEF = registro oficial -> webservices/verdocumento/ver?e=<token> -> iXBRL XHTML.
IBE identity: NIF A-48010615, LEI 5QK37QC7NWOJ8D7WVQ45. SAN=A39000013, BBVA=A48265169.
Exact corpus slots (H1-2024, H2-2024, H1-2025, H2-2025, H1-2026; FY2024, FY2025) are all enumerated for SAN, BBVA and IBE.
limitations: The IPP ?t={GUID} intermediate is ephemeral (changes per visit) and must NOT be used as canonical identity; use the stable nreg (IPP) / registro oficial (ESEF) as source_registration_no and resolve the stable ?e= token via discovery.
